# Platform

## Summary
Where a piece publishes: Instagram Reel / Story / Post, TikTok, YouTube,
Facebook. An option set rather than a string, so every consumer keys off a
stable value.

## Why the hues are derived, not branded
Each platform carries a `hue` resolved through `stateColor`, which returns a
checked background/foreground pair mixed in oklch from the design tokens. The
brand palette is deliberately **not** reproduced as literals: a linked Theme
reskins every chip, and a fill can never drift out of contrast with its own text
because both derive from one hue. `PLATFORM_COLORS` is the map the month
Calendar consumes as `@kindColors`.

## Exports
`PLATFORMS` (value, label, two-letter `short` for calendar chips, hue, icon),
`platformStyle()` with a graceful unknown-value fallback, plus label/short/icon/
colour maps and the `PlatformField` enum with atom and embedded chips.
